project.name: sample
project.summary: Command-line todo list backed by SQLite, plus a small web fetch helper.

externals.name: HTTP API
externals.note: server at baseUrl, not in this repo

folders.tests: pytest suite for storage and validation.
folders.web: Browser-side helpers for fetching and showing todos.

app/cli.py.summary: Argparse entry point. Parses add/list/done and calls TodoStore on todos.db.

app/store.py.summary: TodoStore wraps a SQLite connection with add, complete and list operations on a todos table.

app/validate.py.summary: Title cleaning: rejects empty titles, collapses whitespace, truncates to MAX_LEN (120).

tests/test_store.py.summary: pytest tests for TodoStore and clean_title.

web/api.js.summary: Fetches todos from an HTTP API, renders them as list items, and polls on an interval.

functions.app/cli.py::main: Parses argv (cmd plus optional title), opens TodoStore('todos.db') and runs add, done or list, printing the result.
functions.app/store.py::TodoStore: Owns one sqlite3 connection and the todos table.
functions.app/store.py::TodoStore.__init__: Connects to the database at path and creates the todos table if missing.
functions.app/store.py::TodoStore.add: Cleans the title with clean_title, inserts it with done=0 and returns the new row id.
functions.app/store.py::TodoStore.complete: Sets done=1 for todo_id. Returns True only if exactly one row changed.
functions.app/store.py::TodoStore.list: Selects all rows and returns them as dicts with id, title and a bool done.
functions.app/validate.py::clean_title: Raises ValueError for None or blank input, collapses internal whitespace, then truncates to 120 chars.
functions.tests/test_store.py::TestStore: Groups TodoStore tests on an in-memory database.
functions.tests/test_store.py::TestStore.test_add_: Adds a messy title and checks list() returns it cleaned and not done.
functions.tests/test_store.py::TestStore.test_comp: Completes a new todo and checks it is reported done.
complete() on an unknown id returns False.
functions.tests/test_store.py::test_clean_title_re: Empty, blank and None titles raise ValueError.
functions.web/api.js::fetchTodos: GETs baseUrl/todos and returns the parsed JSON.
functions.web/api.js::renderList: Replaces el.innerHTML with one li per todo title.
functions.web/api.js::Poller.start: Calls fn every intervalMs via setInterval and keeps the timer id.

sequences.title: cli add
sequences.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  actor U as User
  participant C as cli.py
  participant S as TodoStore
  participant V as validate.py
  participant DB as todos.db
  U->>C: main(["add", title])
  C->>S: add(title)
  S->>V: clean_title(title)
  V-->>S: cleaned title
  S->>DB: INSERT todos
  DB-->>S: lastrowid
  S-->>C: id
  C-->>U: print id

sequences.title: cli done
sequences.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  actor U as User
  participant C as cli.py
  participant S as TodoStore
  participant DB as todos.db
  U->>C: main(["done", id])
  C->>S: complete(int(id))
  S->>DB: UPDATE todos SET done = 1
  DB-->>S: rowcount
  S-->>C: True or False
